channel.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
channel.desc: Auctioneer Bee Harford and restorer Lauren Wood chop to it in Leeds, helping retired butcher Michael, whose life has been turned upside down not once but twice. After losing his first wife Denise to a liver condition when their daughter was still young, he went on to lose his second wife, Cathy, years later when she was diagnosed with leukaemia. Michael is surrounded by a lifetime of memories in the house that he shared with Cathy.
